messages:
Maria: Quick sync — PRD for Observability retention launch. Need to lock acceptance criteria + edge cases before we freeze scope. TL;DR: customers want per-route retention, export/PII deletion, and a clear UX for sampling.
Alex: Quick q — do we need per-route retention in v1 or can we do default+opt-in and ship faster?
Maria: Prefer default+opt-in for v1; per-route as P2. Decision needed by EOD Fri. @Tara can you confirm infra constraints?
Tara: Per-route retention is expensive: ~20% more indexing/metadata. For Hosted, we'd need S3-tiering + delayed queries to keep latency SLOs. Dedicated OK if reserved capacity. Recommend defer per-route to v2.
Devon: Edge case: when a route is deleted we must ensure retention policy survives until export/purge. Propose "orphaned route retention" rule (keeps data for N days after route deletion).
Joanne: UX notes: add non-dismissible banner when retention < 30d warning about limited traces + link to export. Also an "export before delete" CTA in route settings.
Samir: Draft acceptance criteria: 
- retention configurable per-tenant, per-environment
- export pipeline success within 24h for >95% of exports
- delete operations respect customer KMS keys and return 200 on success
- UI surfaces retention age and shows warning when under threshold
(We should also add observable metrics: exported_count, purge_failures)
Maria: Nice. Can you turn that into a PRD checklist? Add SLOs: trace export reliability 99.9% and data loss <=1% vs requested retention.
Samir: Will do. Also thinking about fallback when storage is exhausted — auto-tier to cold S3 while preserving encryption. Config draft: 
```
retention:
  default_days: 90
  per_route_enabled: false
  orphaned_route_grace_days: 30
  export_retry: 3
```
Alex: We also need cost projections for Redwood Optimize — product wants per-tenant cost delta for retention tiers. Can infra provide a rough costing model (requests/day -> GB/month)?
Tara: I can run a cost calc but need typical event size distribution. Devon, can you share one-off sample?
Devon: Pushed sample histogram to the doc. NOTE: traces vary wildly between customers.
Joanne: Mobile UI consideration — condensed retention card for small screens; keep primary CTA = Export.
Maria: GDPR / DSAR question: do we expose an immediate purge API for data subject requests? Legal wants delete within 48h for Hosted and 7d for Private by default.
Tara: We can support immediate purge API, but it bypasses cold-tier and will spike egress. Need to document cost and rate limits.
Samir: Updated checklist to include DSAR SLA + audit log entry for every delete. Also add a test scenario for simultaneous exports + purge.
Joanne: Will mock the retention card and the export flow — aim Wed EOD.
Maria: Next steps: Samir -> PRD checklist by Tue; Tara -> infra feasibility + rough cost delta by Tue; Joanne -> UI mocks by Wed EOD. If blockers, tag me. Thanks :rocket: 
dev-bot: PRD draft created: https://confluence.company/redwood/obs-retention-prd (auto) :white_check_mark:
Maria: Thanks — will review and loop in Legal after Samir updates checklist.
